description:
Returns countries with their canonical country IDs used in all other API calls.
When to use: Resolve country names to canonical IDs, or obtain the full list of supported countries. This list rarely changes.
Performance: Fast — static data; safe to cache across calls.
Prerequisites: None.
Investigate: Call once if country-level filtering is needed; cache the result for the session.
Augment: Fetch country IDs before making country-filtered calls to /anomalies or /breaking. Returns: countries, country.ctryid, country.name, country.regions.
name: countries
title: List Countries
